claim_results.claim: The framework includes a document layout analysis and segmentation stage.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The repository contains a concrete layout extraction and segmentation stage built around LayoutExtractor and invoked by run_segmentation_async/run_segmentation_sync.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The pipeline invokes LayoutExtractor, performs bbox merging and caption detection, and processes segmented regions.

claim_results.claim: The framework includes a multimodal content extraction and annotation stage.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The implementation sends segmented visual fragments to a multimodal model and records generated annotation fields.
claim_results.osa_explanation: ImageDescription sends cropped document images and page context to a vision-language model and returns descriptions and recognized text.

claim_results.claim: The framework includes a question answering stage with structured evidence augmentation.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The repository contains segmentation, annotation, BM25 retrieval helpers, and an example notebook, but no question-answering stage or structured evidence-augmented answering pipeline.
claim_results.osa_explanation: No question-answering stage or structured evidence augmentation logic is present.

claim_results.claim: The pipeline is designed for PDF technical documents.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The code directly supports PDF inputs and uses technical-document-specific prompting for fragment annotation.
claim_results.osa_explanation: PDF inputs are detected and converted into page images with utils.process_pdf.

claim_results.claim: The layout detector returns candidate document elements for each page.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The layout detector returns per-page candidate element records in bbox_json.
claim_results.osa_explanation: LayoutExtractor.get_bboxes and get_bboxes_batched return processed detector bounding-box records for document pages.

claim_results.claim: The layout detector records bounding boxes, predicted element classes, and confidence scores for candidate elements.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The direct output schema includes bounding box coordinates, classes/names, and confidence scores.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Detector JSON records include box coordinates, name/class information, and confidence values.

claim_results.claim: The layout detector uses classes for plain text, title, figure, table, table caption, figure caption, isolated formula, and auxiliary elements.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The class map covers the claimed document element categories, including auxiliary/ignored abandon and footnote/caption classes.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The labels mapping defines title, plain text, figure, table, captions, isolate formula, and auxiliary categories such as abandon and footnotes.

claim_results.claim: The pipeline selects caption candidates from the same page when their bounding boxes intersect an expanded search region.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The expanded-region same-page caption-selection logic is implemented directly.
claim_results.osa_explanation: LayoutExtractor contains caption-detection and related-bbox processing methods, invoked by run.py after page detection.

claim_results.claim: Merged visual elements are cropped and sent to the annotation stage.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Merged element image bytes are used by the subsequent annotation loop, though the code combines images rather than always re-cropping a full merged page region.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Related elements are merged before each resulting bbox is cropped and passed to ImageDescription inference.

claim_results.claim: Selected document fragments are processed by a visual language model after segmentation.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Both pipeline modes process selected fragments with a visual language model after segmentation.
claim_results.osa_explanation: ImageDescription performs visual-language-model inference on cropped fragments after layout segmentation.

claim_results.claim: Fragment records include page index, bounding box, layout class, recognized text, and generated multimodal annotation fields.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The output records contain page, box/class metadata and VLM-generated description/text fields.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Output records retain page_num, box, layout name, and add text and description fields from VLM parsing.

claim_results.claim: The method converts visual page structure into fragment-level evidence.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Segmented visual structure is converted into fragment records with annotations suitable as fragment-level evidence.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Each segmented bbox is cropped, annotated by the VLM, and stored as a fragment record.

claim_results.claim: The experiments implement a Base context strategy that supplies only the question and original visual input.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No experimental QA strategy implementation or Base context prompt path exists in the repository.
claim_results.osa_explanation: No Base question-answering context strategy is implemented.

claim_results.claim: The Page-Augmented Retrieval strategy appends page-level context to the prompt.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No Page-Augmented Retrieval prompt construction or page-level evidence appending code was found.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Page images are supplied as VLM context, but there is no QA prompt that appends retrieved page-level evidence.

claim_results.claim: The Localized Fragment Augmentation method appends the most useful local evidence for each question.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No code appends retrieved local fragments to a question prompt.
claim_results.osa_explanation: No question-conditioned local evidence selection or prompt augmentation stage is present.

claim_results.claim: Fragment relevance uses the combined recognized text and generated annotation.
claim_results.gold_explanation: BM25 indexes only the description field, while nearest-element search ranks by centroid similarity; no relevance method combines recognized text with generated annotation.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Records contain text and descriptions, but no relevance computation combines them for retrieval.

claim_results.claim: The final Localized Fragment Augmentation prompt combines the user question, required visual input, page-level evidence, and ranked local evidence.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No final LFA prompt or QA prompt assembly of these components exists in the repository.

claim_results.claim: The pipeline uses a strict context budget for prompt construction.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No prompt context budgeting or token/material budget enforcement was found.

claim_results.claim: The framework uses the visual modality only for selected segment types such as figures and tables.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The VLM loop processes every non-ignored bbox, including plain text and title elements, rather than restricting visual processing to figures and tables.

claim_results.claim: The implementation converts PDF files to OpenCV image arrays.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The implementation explicitly returns OpenCV BGR image arrays for PDF pages.

claim_results.claim: The implementation uses DocLayout-YOLO for core segmentation.
claim_results.gold_explanation: DocLayout-YOLO is the core layout segmentation model.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The code imports YOLOv10 from doclayout_yolo, downloads DocLayout-YOLO weights, and uses the model for prediction.

claim_results.claim: DocLayout-YOLO recognizes and categorizes ten document element types.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The implementation defines ten document element types for model output interpretation.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The labels mapping explicitly defines ten document element types, indexed from 0 through 9.

claim_results.claim: Decorative abandon elements are excluded from the segmentation output.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Abandon elements are retained internally with ignore=True but excluded from the final VLM-processed result set.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Detections named abandon are marked with ignore=True, and run.py excludes ignored detections from VLM processing.

claim_results.claim: The model removes duplicate detections using IoU-based merging.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Duplicate detections are removed/merged using an IoU-based method.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The _process_bbox_results method calls merge_duplicated, which is documented and implemented as IoU-based duplicate merging.

claim_results.claim: IoU-based merging uses a configured IoU threshold.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The IoU merge threshold is configurable through a function parameter and used in the merge decision.
claim_results.osa_explanation: merge_duplicated accepts an iou_threshold parameter, and the caller configures it as 0.75.

claim_results.claim: IoU-based merging uses the model confidence level on the label.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The merge logic uses label grouping and confidence scores when consolidating duplicate boxes.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The duplicate-merging implementation sorts detections by descending confidence and retains the higher-confidence box.

claim_results.claim: Detected elements include bounding-box coordinates, confidence scores, centroid computations, and page-level metadata.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Detected elements contain the claimed layout and page metadata fields.
claim_results.osa_explanation: YOLO JSON results provide box coordinates and confidence; processing adds page_num, centroid, image_bytes, and bbox_idx metadata.

claim_results.claim: The implementation computes bounding-box centroids to determine element centers.

claim_results.claim: The post-processing stage pairs figures with captions.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Figure-caption pairing is implemented through label mapping and same-page nearest-element matching.

claim_results.claim: The post-processing stage pairs tables with captions.

claim_results.claim: The post-processing stage pairs formulas with captions.

claim_results.claim: Caption-element relationships are detected using cosine similarity between centroid coordinates.

claim_results.claim: Paired components are combined into unified components.

excluded_claims.claim: The methodology retrieves context at the page segment level.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Segment-level retrieval helpers exist, but no complete context-retrieval methodology is wired into a QA pipeline.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Retrieval filters and ranks bbox fragments within a page, returning page-segment-level evidence records.

excluded_claims.claim: The Localized Fragment Augmentation prompt returns description and recognized text in JSON format.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The description/text JSON prompt exists for fragment annotation, but it is not implemented as a Localized Fragment Augmentation prompt.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The prompt explicitly requests description and recognized text in JSON format with the keys description and text.

excluded_claims.claim: The Page-Augmented Retrieval prompt uses full-page context when generating fragment descriptions.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Full-page context is used for fragment description generation, but no Page-Augmented Retrieval prompt implementation exists.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The prompt requests use of the full-page context, and inference prepares and sends a downsampled full-page image alongside the cropped fragment.

excluded_claims.claim: The system uses Qwen2.5-VL-7b-Instruct besides GPT-4.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: There is support for the Qwen2.5-VL model class, but no concrete Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct default and no GPT-4 model configuration were found.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Qwen2.5-VL support is imported and instantiated for local inference, but there is no explicit GPT-4 model or reference in the provided code.

excluded_claims.claim: After segmentation, Qwen2.5-VL processes each document element separately.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Per-element VLM processing after segmentation is implemented, but the default runner uses API mode and does not specifically configure Qwen2.5-VL for every element.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The runner iterates over valid bounding boxes and calls inference_async or inference separately for each document element.

excluded_claims.claim: Qwen2.5-VL extracts semantic descriptions from document elements.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The annotation component can use Qwen2.5-VL and stores semantic descriptions, but the configured default model/API path is not specifically Qwen2.5-VL.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The VLM prompt asks for a detailed description of each document fragment, and the result is stored in the description field.

excluded_claims.claim: Qwen2.5-VL extracts textual content from document elements.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Text extraction from elements is implemented through the VLM annotation path, but it is not statically fixed to Qwen2.5-VL.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The VLM prompt requests recognized text, and parsed results are stored in the text field.

excluded_claims.claim: Each model-condition pair was evaluated on identical inputs.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: This is an experiment-execution/control claim; the repository lacks static manifests or runners proving identical runtime inputs.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The repository contains document layout and OCR processing code but no evaluation pipeline showing that model-condition pairs receive identical inputs.

excluded_claims.claim: The LFA local fragments include captions.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Caption association with fragments is implemented, but no LFA local-fragment list is built.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Although the layout extractor detects captions around figures, there is no LFA fragment construction that includes captions.

excluded_claims.claim: The LFA local fragments include short paragraph excerpts.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The pipeline produces annotated text fragments, but there is no LFA list of short paragraph excerpts.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The repository has OCR text fields and text-box merging, but no LFA local-fragment assembly containing short paragraph excerpts.

excluded_claims.claim: The pipeline orders appended items by relevance.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: A retrieval helper orders records by relevance score, but no appended-evidence list or prompt appending pipeline is implemented.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Although layout elements can be sorted by confidence or cosine similarity in isolated utilities, there is no evidence that appended PAR or LFA items are ordered by relevance.
